from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RevenueRecord(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the document belongs to")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label used as the revenue metric (e.g., 'Total Net Revenues', 'Investment Income')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the revenue metric")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the number as reported (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The time period covered by the report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    revenue_records: list[RevenueRecord]
